title: The MCP dogfood docs describe a slow call's immediate unavailable line and partial phase records
outcome: The MCP dogfood docs describe a slow call's immediate unavailable line and partial phase records
acceptance: The dogfood paragraph of docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md says that a slow call whose phase record has not arrived prints 'unavailable (record not yet received)' at once and its record when it arrives, and that a record in a state that did not time the whole call (evicted, incomplete, cancelled) reads unavailable
